title: Sync fixes, round 4 — arrow on the right

steps.path: Settings → Backup & Sync, when a conversation is too big to sync
steps.headline: The warning’s arrow now sits on the right, shaped like the session switcher’s.
steps.changed: The small triangle on the left is gone; a thin down-arrow on the right edge opens the card.
steps.notice: The header reads cleanly from the left, and the arrow flips up when the card is open.
